source.note: the sacrifice→dies aristocrat-bridge witness: Nantuko Husk's activation cost 'Sacrifice a creature' DIES (CR 701.21a a sacrificed permanent moves from the battlefield directly to its owner's graveyard → 700.4 dies), feeding Blood Artist's 'whenever this or another creature dies' subscription. A drain-per-sacrifice value engine, NOT a loop — the smallest honest unit witnessing the bridge:sacrifice-to-dies EDGE (the ADR-2 sac→ltb:to-graveyard bridge arm, PortGraphEngine.AddCoarseRulesEdges (3)).

judge.ref: ij 2026-07-17 b7 — sac->dies bridge GREEN (creature cover, RiP-capped); bridge:sacrifice-to-dies genuinely distinct (zone-change death bridge); PROCEED

Nantuko Husk.note: the fodder — 'Sacrifice a creature' (NOT 'another': the Husk MAY sacrifice itself, so NO exclude_self — the sound contrast to Ruthless Knave's 'another creature')
the sacrifice EVENT; carries manner=sacrificed but NOT to — the destination is supplied by the bridge rule (CR 701.21a), not proven on the emit
the Husk's own +2/+2 payoff (self); off the bridge path, included for faithful derivation

Blood Artist.note: 'whenever THIS or another creature dies' — any creature, any controller; no exclusion (fires on itself too)

notes: the sac→dies bridge: N2's manner=sacrificed removal is a death (CR 701.21a→700.4), supplying the to=graveyard B1 watches. GREEN because the sacrificed subject creature Subsumes B1's dies-watch filter creature EXACTLY (creature ⊆ creature, no subtype straddle) and control=you ⊆ any — the ruthless-knave GREEN-cover precedent (policy:subscription:subject-subsumes-green). Reliability capped: the bridge's inferred to=graveyard is a graveyard-replacement (Rest in Peace) board prune — if the sacrificed creature is exiled instead it never dies, so B1 never fires.

bridges.desc: a sacrifice (removal:creature[manner=sacrificed] emit) feeds a dies-trigger (removal:creature[to=graveyard] subscription): CR 701.21a — to sacrifice a permanent is to move it from the battlefield directly to its owner's graveyard — so it dies (CR 700.4, leaves-the-battlefield to graveyard). The bridge supplies the to=graveyard destination the parser proves only as manner=sacrificed (the ADR-2 sac-consume → ltb:…:to-graveyard-consume arm, PortGraphEngine.AddCoarseRulesEdges (3)). Ceiling GREEN — a deterministic rules zone-change (contrast the AMBER cross-resource untap→mana / copy→cast bridges): the edge is GREEN when the sacrificed type provably covers the dies-watch filter, reliability-capped only by a graveyard-replacement (Rest in Peace) board prune.

assertions.because: the sacrificed subject creature Subsumes B1's dies-watch filter creature exactly (creature ⊆ creature, no subtype straddle), control=you ⊆ any — the GREEN-cover branch
the bridge infers to=graveyard from manner=sacrificed (CR 701.21a); a graveyard-replacement (Rest in Peace) redirects the sacrificed creature to exile so it never dies — B1 does not fire
unit=pairwise: a one-shot drain-per-sacrifice value engine (Blood Artist's life drain never refuels the Husk's fodder) — not a repeating cycle, no §10 SDF balance
